record.final_answer:
Four SKUs need reordering (total stock across both warehouses compared with each SKU's level in `reorder.csv`):

| SKU | Stock | Reorder level |
|---|---|---|
| BX-100 | 23 (14 north + 9 south) | 25 |
| CL-310 | 5 (3 + 2) | 5 (at the level, which counts) |
| EN-512 | 0 | 10 |
| GH-118 | 7 | 12 |

BX-220, DR-045 and FT-760 are above their levels.

The plain command `python3 restock.py exports/stock-2026-10-27.csv` fails with "column 'sku' not found". The portal's file starts with an invisible byte-order mark, so the script reads the first column as `\ufeffsku` instead of `sku`. The script already has an option for this: I ran it with `--encoding utf-8-sig`, and neither the export nor `restock.py` was changed. I also saved this fix to memory so future sessions know to use it.
